description: Add an image (or other file) to a Cloud for WordPress site's media library, from a public URL (WordPress downloads it) or from base64 `data` with a `filename`. Returns the attachment `id` (use as `featured_media` on a post or page via wordpress_request) and its `url` (use in page content). Set `alt_text` to describe the image for accessibility. Up to about 10 MB.

data.description: The file as base64 (a data: URL works). Use this or url.

domain.description: The domain of the Cloud for WordPress site.

filename.description: File name with extension, e.g. `storefront.jpg`. Required with data.

post_id.description: Attach it to this post or page id.

url.description: Public https:// address of the file. Use this or data.

name: wordpress_upload_media
title: Wordpress Upload Media
